name: Insufficient evidence
objective: Validate escalation when a known PO has no evidence supporting a specific root cause.

input.ticket: PO 4500012346 is showing an unexpected purchasing error. The document looks normal to me, but I do not know what is wrong.

missing_information: Exact SAP error message or additional diagnostic evidence

must_not: Claim that the PO is blocked for release.
Claim that the vendor is blocked.
Present an unsupported root cause as confirmed.
